plays.name: funding-updates
plays.description: Fetch a single page (up to 100) of new funding-round updates from the Deepline funding-rounds radar. Pass since to filter by discovery time and use the returned next_cursor to fetch the next page in a subsequent run.

limit.description: Maximum number of updates to return in this page. Defaults to 100.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Return only updates discovered at or after this time.

rows.description: Durable row dataset with one row per funding-round update: update_id, discovered_at, round, amount_usd, announced_at, company_name, company_domain, company_hq_country, company_profile_url, and references columns.

has_more.description: True if another page is available. Rerun with since or a later cursor to continue (this play does not paginate automatically).

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination token from the underlying tool call.

plays.name: job-change-check
plays.description: Detect job changes and return the new company, title, date, and validation evidence.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn profile URL (primary; wins over contact_linkedin). Query strings and fragments are stripped to a canonical URL before validation.

contact_linkedin.description: LinkedIn profile URL alias for linkedin_url (used only when linkedin_url is absent or invalid).

current_domain.description: Bare current-company domain (primary; wins over company_domain).

company_domain.description: Bare current-company domain alias for current_domain (used only when current_domain is absent or invalid).

company_linkedin_url.description: Current company LinkedIn URL (primary; wins over company_linkedin). Query strings and fragments are stripped to a canonical URL before validation.

company_linkedin.description: Current company LinkedIn URL alias for company_linkedin_url (used only when company_linkedin_url is absent or invalid).

contact_full_name.description: Contact full name (primary; wins over full_name).

full_name.description: Contact full name alias for contact_full_name (used only when contact_full_name is absent).

work_email.description: Work email alias for professional_email (used only when professional_email is absent or invalid).

email.description: Generic email. Treated as work email when it matches the company domain, otherwise personal email.

company_name.description: Current company name, passed through custom_fields.

custom_fields.description: Extra scalar context to send with the job-change request.

csv.description: Runtime CSV input path. Headers are matched case-insensitively and tolerate spaces/dashes (e.g. LinkedIn_URL, CURRENT_DOMAIN, "Company LinkedIn URL" all resolve). Source columns are canonicalized in the exported output to SQL-safe snake_case identifiers (trimmed, lowercased, non-alphanumerics folded to "_", leading/trailing "_" stripped) — e.g. LinkedIn_URL -> linkedin_url, "Lead Score" -> lead_score, _anchor_note -> anchor_note. Supported headers include linkedin_url/contact_linkedin, current_domain/company_domain, company_linkedin/company_linkedin_url, contact_full_name/full_name, professional_email/work_email, personal_email, email, title, company_name, and source.

current_domain.description: Bare current company domain. URL shorteners are rejected before provider execution.

rows.description: Durable result dataset with one row per LinkedIn profile and current domain.

pricing.description: Deepline Native job-change is billed only when the provider confirms a successful job change.

freshness.description: stale_contact rows persist without a next expiry. All other statuses are eligible for monthly recheck.

validation_status.description: ready, invalid, or missing_input. Only rows meeting the provider minimum input (an email, or a company anchor plus a contact identifier) reach ready and execute; rows below the minimum are missing_input and never call the provider.

miss_reason.description: Why a row did not run, or null when ready/executed.

validation_warnings.description: Semicolon-joined provenance/conflict/dropped-field notes. Populated when a field was resolved from a non-primary alias column, when a primary and alias were both valid but differed (primary wins), or when a provided value was invalid and dropped. Null when there is nothing to report.
